llm_response.reason: The site contains nearly all scam indicators: 1) fake statistics and vague service/app promises, 2) placeholder text throughout, 3) no functioning navigation or hyperlinks, 4) pricing claims that are not realistic ($0/mo 'Life Time'), 5) heavily redacted and privacy-shielded WHOIS with generic contacts and no identifiable company, 6) ambiguous privacy information, 7) no legitimate update or content history, 8) no business explanation nor credible contact details. These match multiple scam characteristic flags for fake shops/services and information harvesting.
